lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, creating a grid-like spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming defined nodal points of maximum luminance across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-intensity shadow gradient, extending horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank.
